title: Alaska: Anchorage → Seward → Denali
best_time_description: Roads and services fully open, good wildlife visibility, fewer crowds than peak July
description: The most 'once in a lifetime' domestic trip available in the US — raw wilderness that genuinely feels remote.

days.title: Arrive Anchorage
activities: Settle in, short walk on the Tony Knowles Coastal Trail

title: Hawaii: Kauai + Big Island
best_time_description: Avoids peak pricing and humidity of summer
description: Two very different Hawaiian islands — dramatic coastal cliffs and active volcano terrain.

days.title: Na Pali Coast
activities: Kalalau Trail (as far as permit/fitness allows)

title: New Orleans + Nashville
best_time_description: Avoids summer humidity
description: A food and music-driven city trip, very different pace from a nature trip.

title: Southwest Loop: Grand Canyon, Sedona, Antelope Canyon
best_time_description: Summer is brutally hot in this region
description: A different desert Southwest loop, distinct from the Utah Mighty 5.

days.title: Arrive Phoenix/Flagstaff, drive to Grand Canyon

title: Dubai + Abu Dhabi
best_time_description: Summer is 110°F+
description: The best 'splurge city' pick — feels expensive, no visa hassle for Indian passport + valid US visa holders.

days.title: Old Dubai + Burj Khalifa
activities: Burj Khalifa observation deck at sunset

food_culture.name: Gahwa (Arabic coffee)
food_culture.description: Lightly roasted, brewed with cardamom, and poured from a dallah pot into small handle-less cups — refusing the first cup is traditionally seen as declining hospitality. UNESCO-recognized Intangible Cultural Heritage since 2015.

food_culture.name: Machboos
food_culture.description: The UAE's national dish — fragrant spiced rice with chicken, lamb, or seafood, infused with dried lime (loomi) for a tangy depth.

food_culture.name: Karak tea
food_culture.description: Sweet, milky tea spiced with cardamom, originally influenced by South Asian chai — practically Dubai's unofficial daily drink, found from roadside cafeterias to upscale cafés.

food_culture.name: Luqaimat & kunafa
food_culture.description: Luqaimat are sweet fried dumplings drizzled with date syrup; kunafa is a cheese-and-syrup pastry dessert popular across the Gulf and Levant.

food_culture.name: Al Fahidi Cultural Understanding Centre
food_culture.description: A government-run center in Old Dubai offering meals and cultural sessions specifically designed to teach visitors authentic Emirati customs and Bedouin heritage, beyond the skyline.

title: Bali, Indonesia
best_time_description: Dry season
description: A jungle-and-island mix in one trip.

food_culture.name: Nyepi (Day of Silence)
food_culture.description: The Balinese Hindu New Year, marked not with celebration but a full day of island-wide silence — airports close, roads empty, and lights go off. Visitors are expected to observe the same restrictions.

food_culture.name: Babi Guling
food_culture.description: Balinese spit-roasted suckling pig, originally a sacred temple offering — pork is central to Bali's food identity, distinguishing it from the rest of Muslim-majority Indonesia.

food_culture.name: Bebek Betutu
food_culture.description: Duck or chicken slow-cooked in banana leaves with a rich spice marinade, traditionally served at Hindu ceremonies — often requires ordering a day in advance.

food_culture.name: Canang sari offerings
food_culture.description: Small daily woven-palm offerings of flowers and food left outside homes and businesses to honor the gods — a visible, constant part of Balinese Hindu life.

food_culture.name: Base genep
food_culture.description: Bali's foundational spice paste — garlic, turmeric, ginger, galangal, lemongrass, and chili ground together — underlying most traditional dishes on the island.

title: Maldives (+ optional Sri Lanka)
best_time_description: Manta ray season
description: The ultimate overwater villa splurge trip.

days.title: Diving/excursion
activities: Manta ray or reef dive trip

days.title: Fly home or connect to Sri Lanka

food_culture.name: Mas riha (Maldivian tuna curry)
food_culture.description: A coconut-based curry built on tuna rather than chicken or lamb, since fishing — not agriculture — has always defined the Maldivian diet.

food_culture.name: Hedhikaa (short eats)
food_culture.description: Maldivian tea-time snacks like bajiya (fried tuna-and-coconut pastries) and gulha (fish balls) — direct relatives of Indian samosas and Sri Lankan cutlets, served the same way at teatime.

food_culture.name: Ceylon tea
food_culture.description: Sri Lanka is one of the world's great tea producers — a plantation tour near Kandy showing the withering, rolling, and fermenting process is a genuine highlight if extending into Sri Lanka.

food_culture.name: Kiribath & watalappam
food_culture.description: Sri Lankan milk rice (kiribath) is the celebratory dish for New Year and auspicious occasions; watalappam, a coconut-jaggery custard, reflects the island's Malay community influence.

food_culture.name: Spice gardens of Matale
food_culture.description: Sri Lanka's spices — cinnamon, cardamom, pepper, nutmeg — are grown here and were historically believed to have medicinal as well as flavoring value, not just culinary ones.

title: Turkey: Istanbul + Cappadocia + Turquoise Coast
best_time_description: Mild weather, good balloon-flying conditions
description: City history, otherworldly landscape, and coastline in one trip.

food_culture.name: Turkish tea (çay)
food_culture.description: Served in small tulip-shaped glasses, strong and without milk — offered constantly as a gesture of hospitality, and refusing it is considered impolite.

food_culture.name: Turkish coffee & fortune telling
food_culture.description: Slow-brewed and unfiltered, traditionally followed by a fortune-teller (falcı) reading the pattern left by the grounds in the empty cup — a genuine social ritual, not just a novelty.

food_culture.name: Regional cuisine variety
food_culture.description: Turkish food shifts by region — olive-oil vegetable dishes on the Aegean coast, fresh fish in Bodrum, baklava-heavy pastry culture in the east, hearty wheat-and-meat stews (keşkek) in central Anatolia.

food_culture.name: Turkish hospitality (misafirperverlik)
food_culture.description: Guests are offered food and drink almost immediately upon arrival anywhere — home, shop, or hotel — and the phrase 'hoş geldiniz' ('it's good you came') captures a genuinely central cultural value.

food_culture.name: Whirling dervish ceremony
food_culture.description: A Sufi religious ritual (sema) especially associated with Konya — meditative spinning dance representing spiritual ascent, still performed as a living tradition, not just a tourist show.

title: Costa Rica
best_time_description: Dry season
description: Real rainforest immersion, easy visa entry.

days.title: Arrive San Jose, drive to La Fortuna
Drive to San Jose, fly home

food_culture.name: Pura Vida
food_culture.description: Literally 'pure life' — more than a greeting, it's a whole philosophy of living simply, gratefully, and in the moment that genuinely shapes the pace of daily life.

food_culture.name: Gallo pinto
food_culture.description: Costa Rica's everyday breakfast — rice and black beans sautéed with Salsa Lizano, a tangy brown sauce found on nearly every table in the country.

food_culture.name: Casado
food_culture.description: The classic Costa Rican lunch plate — rice, beans, plantains, salad, and a choice of protein — named for resembling 'what my wife would make.'

food_culture.name: Costa Rican coffee
food_culture.description: Grown in the misty Central Valley highlands and traditionally brewed through a cloth chorreador filter — genuinely high-quality, and a point of national pride.

food_culture.name: Sodas
food_culture.description: Small, family-run diners serving home-style Tico food at low prices — eating at a soda is a more authentic introduction to the culture than most restaurants aimed at tourists.

title: Georgia + Armenia
best_time_description: Mild mountain weather
description: The 'nobody I know has been here' pick — off the radar for most travelers.

food_culture.name: The Georgian supra
food_culture.description: A ceremonial feast that can run for hours, led by a tamada (toastmaster) whose toasts — to family, guests, ancestors, and peace — set the rhythm of the entire meal. An empty table is considered shameful.

food_culture.name: Khachapuri & khinkali
food_culture.description: Khachapuri is Georgia's cheese-filled bread, with a dozen regional varieties (the boat-shaped Adjarian version topped with a raw egg is the most photographed); khinkali are pleated dumplings eaten by the knob, which is traditionally left uneaten.

food_culture.name: Qvevri wine
food_culture.description: Georgia calls itself the cradle of viticulture — evidence at Gadachrili Gora suggests winemaking here 8,000 years ago, still using the same qvevri clay-vessel fermentation method.

food_culture.name: Lavash & khorovats
food_culture.description: Armenia's UNESCO-protected paper-thin flatbread, baked in a clay tonir oven, is the universal utensil for wrapping khorovats — Armenian charcoal-grilled meat skewers.

food_culture.name: Dolma
food_culture.description: Grape leaves or vegetables stuffed with spiced meat and rice — claimed by Armenia as a national dish, though variations of it appear across the Caucasus, Balkans, and Levant.

title: Seattle → Denver: Rainier to the Rockies
best_time_description: Beartooth Highway is only open roughly Memorial Day to mid-October; late June through early September gives the widest margin against snow closures and lingering road work.
description: A camping/budget-conscious national-parks traverse from the Pacific Northwest into the northern Rockies — five parks, one legendary high-altitude drive, and enough distance each day to make it feel like a real journey rather than a highlight reel.

days.title: Seattle → Mount Rainier
activities: Sunset at Reflection Lakes if the sky cooperates
days.coffee_wifi_spot: Wildberry Restaurant, Ashford — weak signal, worth topping up devices before you head further in

days.title: Rainier → Spokane (staging day)
activities: Morning hike near Sunrise if road is open
days.coffee_wifi_spot: Indaba Coffee, Spokane — reliable wifi for a remote-work morning before the border-adjacent stretch

days.title: Spokane → Glacier National Park
activities: Drive Going-to-the-Sun Road if fully open (check dates — often not clear until June)

days.title: Glacier full day
activities: Hidden Lake Overlook from Logan Pass

days.title: Glacier → Beartooth Highway → Red Lodge
activities: Drive the Beartooth Highway (one of the highest paved roads in the US — build in extra time for pull-offs)
Arrive Red Lodge, MT for the night
days.coffee_wifi_spot: Red Lodge Books & Tea — small-town wifi, good enough for email

days.title: Red Lodge → Yellowstone (north)
activities: Enter via the Beartooth's southern descent
Lamar Valley wildlife drive at dusk

days.title: Yellowstone full day
activities: Old Faithful and the Upper Geyser Basin
days.lodging_suggestion: Old Faithful-area or Grant Village campground

days.title: Yellowstone → Grand Teton
activities: String Lake for a quieter alternative
days.lodging_suggestion: Colter Bay or Gros Ventre campground

days.title: Grand Teton → Denver (or fly out of Jackson)
activities: Long drive south, or fly out of Jackson Hole to skip the final leg
days.drive_time: 8 hrs to Denver / 20 min to Jackson airport

title: Cartagena + Medellín, Colombia
best_time_description: December to April is Colombia's dry season on both the Caribbean coast and in the Andes — the most comfortable window for walking Cartagena's Old Town and day-tripping from Medellín.
description: Colonial color on the Caribbean coast, then spring-like mountain air in the 'City of Eternal Spring' — colonial history and Pablo-Escobar-era transformation, back to back.

days.title: Arrive Cartagena
activities: Sunset from the ramparts at Café del Mar

days.title: Cartagena Old Town
activities: Walking tour of the Walled City

days.title: Cartagena → Medellín (fly)
activities: Explore El Poblado in the evening

days.title: Medellín city + Comuna 13
activities: Comuna 13 graffiti tour and outdoor escalators

days.title: Guatapé day trip
activities: Climb El Peñol rock for the reservoir view

days.title: Coffee region taste of Antioquia
activities: Day trip to a working coffee farm

food_culture.name: Arepa
food_culture.description: A simple maize flatbread that varies by region — thin and plain in Bogotá, cheese-stuffed and fried in Cartagena, sweetened in Medellín — found at every meal, on every street corner.

food_culture.name: Bandeja paisa
food_culture.description: A hearty Medellín specialty piled with ground beef, chorizo, pork belly, beans, plantain, avocado, and an arepa — originally built to sustain farm laborers.

food_culture.name: Colombian coffee culture
food_culture.description: Coffee is central to daily social life, typically paired with afternoon desserts like enyucado (a cassava-coconut cake) in a ritual that bridges the country's coastal and inland food traditions.

food_culture.name: Coastal ceviche
food_culture.description: The Caribbean coast (Cartagena) favors citrus-forward raw fish dishes and fried seafood, distinct from the heartier, meat-focused cuisine of inland Medellín and Bogotá.

title: Cusco, Sacred Valley + Machu Picchu, Peru
best_time_description: The dry season (April to October) gives clearer skies over Machu Picchu and easier trekking; book Machu Picchu entry tickets 2-3 months ahead regardless of season.
description: The classic Inca-empire arc: acclimatize in Cusco, ease into altitude through the Sacred Valley, then the citadel itself at dawn.

days.title: Arrive Cusco
activities: Short walk through the Plaza de Armas

days.title: Machu Picchu
activities: Early entry to beat the crowds and heat
Optional Huayna Picchu climb (book well ahead)
days.lodging_suggestion: Aguas Calientes or back to Cusco

days.title: Return to Cusco
activities: Rest afternoon, San Blas neighborhood for coffee
days.coffee_wifi_spot: La Bodega 138, San Blas — reliable wifi for a remote-work afternoon

food_culture.name: Ceviche
food_culture.description: Peru's national dish and a UNESCO-recognized piece of intangible cultural heritage since 2004 — raw fish cured in lime with chili and onion, at its best in Lima but found nationwide.

food_culture.name: Pisco sour
food_culture.description: Peru's national cocktail — pisco brandy, lime juice, syrup, and egg white — a genuine point of pride and rivalry with Chile, which also claims pisco as its own.

food_culture.name: Lomo saltado
food_culture.description: A stir-fried beef dish with soy sauce and french fries, reflecting Peru's significant Chinese (chifa) immigrant influence on everyday cooking.

food_culture.name: Cuy (guinea pig)
food_culture.description: A traditional Andean dish, especially associated with the Cusco region — crispy skin, tender meat, served with native potatoes. A genuinely adventurous try for most visitors.

food_culture.name: Aji de gallina
food_culture.description: Shredded chicken in a creamy sauce built on ají amarillo, a native yellow chili with fruity heat rather than sharp spice — a signature dish of the Andean highlands.

title: El Nido, Palawan, Philippines
best_time_description: Dry season is December to May; February to April brings the clearest skies and calmest seas for island hopping, though it's also the busiest stretch.
description: Limestone karsts, hidden lagoons, and reef straight off the boat — genuinely one of the most dramatic island-hopping stretches anywhere, and a 14-day visa-free entry on an Indian passport alone.

days.title: Arrive El Nido
activities: Fly into El Nido (Lio) or via Puerto Princesa plus a 5-6 hr van transfer

days.title: Nacpan Beach
activities: Rent a scooter to Nacpan and Calitang twin beaches

days.title: Free day or Tour B/D
activities: Optional multi-day sailing expedition toward Coron
Or a slower day: snorkeling gear rental and a quiet cove

food_culture.name: Adobo
food_culture.description: Meat slow-stewed in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, and peppercorns — the Philippines' most iconic dish, with every family keeping its own version.

food_culture.name: Fiesta & lechon
food_culture.description: Every town holds its own fiesta honoring a patron saint, centered on lechon — a whole roasted pig, spit-roasted for hours, that functions as a genuine symbol of abundance and community.

food_culture.name: Bayanihan
food_culture.description: A core Filipino value of community and mutual aid — showing up with food for someone, whether they asked or not, is a direct expression of it.

food_culture.name: Kamayan
food_culture.description: Eating with bare hands directly off banana leaves, shared family-style — a tradition that emphasizes the communal, connective role food plays in Filipino life.

food_culture.name: Sinigang
food_culture.description: A sour tamarind-based soup loaded with vegetables and meat or seafood — considered the ultimate Filipino comfort food.

title: Belgrade + Novi Sad, Serbia
best_time_description: Late spring (May-June) and early fall (September) have the mildest weather; summer gets hot in concrete-heavy Belgrade.
description: An unpolished, underrated Balkan capital plus a laid-back river city 35 minutes away by train — genuine off-the-beaten-path Europe at budget prices.

days.title: Arrive Belgrade
activities: Settle in, evening walk through Skadarlija's bohemian quarter

days.title: Belgrade fortress + center
activities: Kalemegdan Fortress at the Sava/Danube confluence

days.title: Belgrade neighborhoods
activities: Floating river bars (splavovi) in the evening

days.title: Day trip to Novi Sad
activities: Old Town and the Name of Mary Church

days.title: Novi Sad overnight or Belgrade leisure
activities: Optional: stay overnight in Novi Sad for a second, slower day
Otherwise a relaxed final day in Belgrade's cafes
days.coffee_wifi_spot: Kafeterija, Belgrade — solid wifi for a remote-work morning

food_culture.name: Rakija
food_culture.description: Serbia's fruit brandy — plum (šljivovica) is the most common — offered as a welcome drink to any guest and central to nearly every celebration.

food_culture.name: Slava
food_culture.description: A uniquely Serbian Orthodox custom where each family celebrates its own patron saint once a year with a large feast for friends — being invited to one is a genuine sign you've been welcomed as family.

food_culture.name: Meze & ajvar
food_culture.description: Shared small-plate spreads of cured meats, cheeses like kajmak, and ajvar (a roasted red pepper relish) typically accompanied by rakija or wine, especially at slavas and gatherings.

food_culture.name: Kafana coffee culture
food_culture.description: Strong, Turkish-style coffee enjoyed at length in traditional kafanas (taverns) — a genuine social institution for long, unhurried conversation.

food_culture.name: Pasulj & punjena paprika
food_culture.description: White bean stew and stuffed peppers are Serbian home-cooking staples — hearty, slow-cooked dishes central to everyday family meals.

title: Mexico City + Riviera Maya
best_time_description: November to April is the dry season across both the highlands and the Yucatán coast — warm, low humidity, and outside hurricane season.
description: Two very different Mexicos back to back — high-altitude capital with world-class food and museums, then Caribbean cenotes and Maya ruins on the coast.

days.title: Teotihuacán day trip
activities: Climb the Pyramid of the Sun
Walk the Avenue of the Dead

days.title: Mexico City → Cancún → Playa del Carmen
activities: Transfer to Playa del Carmen, stroll Quinta Avenida

days.title: Cenotes + Akumal
activities: Swim Gran Cenote or Cenote Azul
Snorkel with sea turtles at Akumal (certified guide)

days.title: Tulum
activities: Tulum ruins at opening (8am) to beat the heat and crowds

days.title: Chichén Itzá day trip
activities: Cenote stop on the way back

food_culture.name: Día de los Muertos
food_culture.description: Not Mexican Halloween — a UNESCO-recognized celebration of loved ones who have passed, with ofrenda altars, marigolds, and the belief that spirits return to join the living for the day.

food_culture.name: Hanal Pixán
food_culture.description: The Yucatán Peninsula's own two-day version of Day of the Dead, with region-specific food like mucbipollo — a large tamale baked in an underground pit, distinct from the rest of the country's traditions.

food_culture.name: Pan de muerto
food_culture.description: Sweet bread baked in the shape of skulls or bones for Día de los Muertos, believed to comfort the souls of the departed when placed on the ofrenda.

food_culture.name: Mexico City street food
food_culture.description: Tacos al pastor, elote, and tamales define the capital's street food scene — genuinely central to daily life, not just tourist novelty.

food_culture.name: Mezcal & tequila regions
food_culture.description: Both distilled from agave but genuinely distinct — tequila from blue agave near Jalisco, mezcal from a wider variety of agave with a signature smokiness from roasting the plant underground.

title: Montana: West Glacier → Lake McDonald → Logan Pass → Many Glacier → East Glacier
best_time_description: Late June through mid-September for full Going-to-the-Sun Road access and open trails. Bear spray required on every hike.
description: A one-directional traverse of Glacier National Park's most iconic sections, west entrance to east — the 'Crown of the Continent' earns the name.

days.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road → Logan Pass
days.drive_time: Full-day drive with stops, ~2.5 hrs without

days.title: Two Medicine / East Glacier
activities: Two Medicine Valley hike or lake cruise

days.title: Depart
activities: Return drive or fly out of Glacier Park International (FCA)

title: New Mexico: Santa Fe → Taos → Los Alamos → Albuquerque
best_time_description: Spring (April-May) or fall (September-October) for mild weather. Late summer is chile harvest season if food is a priority.
description: Northern New Mexico's compact core — adobe architecture, Ancestral Puebloan cliff dwellings, and green-or-red chile at every stop. (White Sands and Carlsbad Caverns sit 4+ hours south and are their own separate trip, not part of this loop.)

days.title: Santa Fe
activities: Santa Fe Plaza and historic district

days.title: Santa Fe → Bandelier → Los Alamos
days.lodging_suggestion: Los Alamos or back to Santa Fe

days.title: Chimayó
activities: Chimayó red chile and El Santuario
days.drive_time: ~45 min from Taos toward Santa Fe

title: Michigan: Traverse City → Leland → Empire → Mackinac Island
best_time_description: June-August for full beach and dune access; visit Traverse City in July-August for peak cherry season.
description: A south-to-north Michigan run through Leelanau Peninsula wine country and the Sleeping Bear Dunes, ending on the car-free Mackinac Island.

title: North Georgia Mountains: Blue Ridge → Helen → Dahlonega → Tallulah Falls
best_time_description: Fall (October-November) for foliage, or spring for wildflowers and waterfall flow. This loop stays entirely in North Georgia's mountains — Savannah and the coast are 4+ hours away and a separate trip.
description: A compact North Georgia mountain loop — waterfalls, a Bavarian-style alpine village, and wine country, all within about an hour of each other.

days.title: Blairsville & the AT
activities: Blood Mountain day-hike section of the Appalachian Trail

days.title: Tallulah Gorge
activities: Tallulah Gorge suspension bridge and overlooks

title: Oregon: Crater Lake → McKenzie Bridge → Columbia River Gorge → Portland
best_time_description: Late June through September for the most reliable weather and full mountain-pass access. The Wallowas and the far south coast are separate trips, not part of this central/north route.
description: A south-to-north drive through Oregon's volcanic centerpiece, old-growth forest swimming holes, and the waterfall-lined Columbia River Gorge, ending in Portland.

days.title: Crater Lake sunrise
activities: Garfield Peak or Watchman Peak hike

days.title: Drive to the Gorge
activities: Travel day toward Columbia River Gorge

title: North Alabama: Huntsville → Fort Payne → Cheaha
best_time_description: Spring or fall for mild hiking weather. Gulf Shores and the coast are 5+ hours south and a separate trip.
description: Northeast Alabama's Appalachian foothills — a rocket-science museum, a canyon deeper than expected, and the state's highest point.

days.title: Fort Payne
activities: Little River Canyon National Preserve hike

title: Northwest Arkansas Ozarks: Bentonville → Eureka Springs → Jasper
best_time_description: Spring for waterfalls at peak flow, fall for foliage. Crater of Diamonds and Hot Springs are 3+ hours south and a separate trip.
description: A tight Ozark Mountains loop — world-class art in Bentonville, Victorian charm in Eureka Springs, and the wildest stretch of the Buffalo National River.

days.title: Bentonville
activities: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art

days.title: Hemmed-In Hollow Falls
activities: Hike to the tallest waterfall between the Rockies and Appalachians

title: California: Yosemite & the Sierra Nevada
best_time_description: Late May-June for peak waterfall flow, or September for thinner crowds. Tioga Road is snow-closed roughly November-May. Big Sur, San Francisco, and LA are separate trips — this stays in the Sierra.
description: California's High Sierra at its most concentrated — granite domes, waterfalls, and giant sequoias, without the 6-hour detour to the coast or LA.

days.title: Yosemite Valley
activities: Mist Trail to Vernal & Nevada Falls

days.title: Half Dome or Valley floor
activities: Half Dome (permit required) or an easier Valley loop

title: Connecticut & the Litchfield Hills
best_time_description: Fall for foliage in the Litchfield Hills, or summer for Mystic's waterfront.
description: Connecticut is small enough to genuinely span in one trip — quiet Taconic Range hiking and wine country in the northwest corner, then a historic seafaring town on the coast.

title: Delaware: Wilmington → Rehoboth Beach
best_time_description: Late spring or early fall for smaller crowds; summer for full beach-town energy at Rehoboth.
description: Delaware's small size means a genuine north-to-south crossing fits in a long weekend — du Pont-family estates up north, boardwalk beach town down south.

days.title: Drive south to the coast
activities: Bombay Hook National Wildlife Refuge (en route)

title: South Florida & the Keys: Miami → Everglades → Key West
best_time_description: December-April, Florida's dry season — far more comfortable Everglades hiking and lower hurricane risk than summer.
description: The Everglades' 'river of grass' and the Overseas Highway's island-hopping, back to back — two completely different sides of South Florida in one trip.

days.title: Drive the Overseas Highway
days.drive_time: ~3 hrs from Everglades City to the Lower Keys

days.title: Depart
activities: Fly out of Key West (EYW) or drive back to Miami

title: Idaho: Sawtooth Mountains → Sun Valley
best_time_description: Late July-early August for peak wildflowers and stable weather, or late September for aspen color against the granite peaks.
description: Over 400 alpine lakes in a mountain range most people outside Idaho have never heard of — genuinely uncrowded compared to any comparably scenic range.

title: Chicago & Starved Rock
best_time_description: May-October for the best Chicago weather and full waterfall flow at Starved Rock (peaks in spring).
description: World-class city food and architecture, with genuine sandstone-canyon wilderness less than two hours away.

title: Central Indiana: Indianapolis → Brown County
best_time_description: Fall for Brown County foliage, or race weekend (late May) if the Indy 500 is a priority.
description: Indianapolis's motorsports history and museums, paired with Brown County's genuinely hilly, un-flat-Indiana hiking an hour south.

title: Northeast Iowa: Decorah → Dubuque
best_time_description: Fall for driftless-region foliage, or summer for the full waterfall hikes.
description: Iowa's genuinely hilly 'driftless' northeast corner — waterfalls, a year-round ice cave, and a Mississippi River town, nothing like the flat-farmland stereotype.

days.title: Depart
activities: Return drive or connect via Cedar Rapids (CID)

title: Kansas Flint Hills Loop
best_time_description: June-August for wildflowers, warm evenings, and the Symphony in the Flint Hills outdoor performance if the dates align.
description: The largest intact tallgrass prairie left on Earth — free-roaming bison, limestone ledges, and small towns where ranching is still a living tradition.

title: Central Kentucky: Louisville → Bardstown → Lexington → Mammoth Cave
best_time_description: Spring (Derby season, April-May) or fall for mild weather and thinner crowds at Mammoth Cave.
description: The Bourbon Trail's distillery towns bookended by the world's longest cave system — pace the tastings, don't overpack the day.

title: Acadia & Downeast Maine
best_time_description: June-August for full trail and Park Loop Road access, or September for foliage and thinner crowds.
description: Granite cliffs dropping into the Atlantic, Acadia's cliffside hikes, and a lobster roll at the end of every day.

days.title: Depart
activities: Drive to Bangor (BGR) or continue to Portland

title: Chesapeake Bay: Annapolis → Eastern Shore
best_time_description: Spring or fall for comfortable sailing and walking weather. Summer brings peak crab season if food is a priority.
description: Sailing culture, steamed blue crab, and pastel Eastern Shore towns — a tight loop around the Chesapeake's western and eastern banks.

title: Cape Cod & Boston
best_time_description: Summer for full beach-town energy and whale watching; September for the same coastline with a fraction of the crowds.
description: Revolutionary history in Boston, then 70 miles of Cape Cod coastline out to Provincetown's dunes.

days.title: Drive to the Cape
activities: Hyannis and the Cape Cod beach towns

days.title: Woods Hole
activities: Ferry day trip to Martha's Vineyard or Nantucket

title: Minnesota's North Shore & Boundary Waters
best_time_description: July-August for full Boundary Waters access — overnight permits sell out fast, book ahead.
description: Over a million roadless acres reachable only by canoe, plus Lake Superior's dramatic North Shore.

days.title: Duluth
activities: Jay Cooke State Park gorge hike

days.title: Ely
activities: Boundary Waters day paddle or guided trip

title: Natchez Trace: Vicksburg → Natchez
best_time_description: Spring for blooming dogwoods and azaleas along the Trace, or fall for lower humidity.
description: A slow drive down the historic Natchez Trace, antebellum history, and a genuine waterfall surprise in Mississippi's southwest corner.

title: Missouri Ozarks: Lake of the Ozarks → Current River → Branson
best_time_description: Summer for float trips and lake activities; spring/fall for hiking Ha Ha Tonka's trails without the heat.
description: Castle ruins over the Lake of the Ozarks, a spring-fed float down the Current River, and Branson's live entertainment to close it out.

days.title: Ha Ha Tonka State Park
activities: Castle ruins hike over the Lake of the Ozarks

days.title: Current River float trip
activities: Canoe or float the Current River

title: Nebraska Panhandle & Sandhills
best_time_description: Late February-April for the spectacular sandhill crane migration, or summer for the full Sandhills byway drive.
description: The Oregon Trail's most iconic landmark and 272 miles of grass-stabilized dunes found nowhere else in this form in North America.

title: Las Vegas & Red Rock Country
best_time_description: Spring or fall for comfortable desert hiking temperatures — summer hiking here can be genuinely dangerous.
description: Neon and casinos fifteen minutes from 200,000 acres of red rock desert most visitors never leave the Strip to see.

title: White Mountains & Lake Winnipesaukee
best_time_description: Late September-mid October for peak Kancamagus Highway foliage, or summer for full trail access.
description: 1,200 miles of trail and the highest peak in the Northeast, with a lakeside wind-down at Winnipesaukee.

title: Jersey Shore: Island Beach to Cape May
best_time_description: Summer for full boardwalk energy, expecting weekend Parkway traffic; shoulder season (May, September) for the same beaches with fewer crowds.
description: 130 miles of Jersey coastline from wild barrier-island dunes to Victorian Cape May, boardwalk culture the whole way down.

title: Catskills Waterfalls & Scenic Byway
best_time_description: Late September-mid October for peak foliage, or spring for waterfalls at full snowmelt flow.
description: Waterfall hikes and the birthplace of the Hudson River School of painting, under two hours from New York City but genuinely rural.

title: Blue Ridge North Carolina: Asheville → Cherokee → Boone
best_time_description: Fall (September-November) for Blue Ridge Parkway foliage, or late spring for wildflowers with fewer crowds. The Outer Banks are 7+ hours east and a separate trip.
description: 'America's Favorite Drive' anchors a loop through craft-beer Asheville, the Smokies, and high mountain towns.

title: Theodore Roosevelt National Park & the Enchanted Highway
best_time_description: Late spring or fall for mild badlands temperatures and thinner crowds than comparable Western parks.
description: Pastel badlands that genuinely shaped a president's conservation legacy, plus a 32-mile drive of giant folk-art metal sculptures.

title: Hocking Hills, Ohio
best_time_description: Spring for peak waterfall flow, fall for foliage — both with thinner crowds than summer.
description: Sandstone gorges and caves an hour and a half from Columbus — genuinely surprising terrain for the Midwest.

title: Tulsa → Turner Falls → Oklahoma City
best_time_description: Spring or fall for festival season and mild temperatures.
description: Tulsa's Art Deco skyline and urban wilderness, a swimming-hole waterfall detour, and Oklahoma City's Western heritage.

title: Philadelphia & Lancaster County
best_time_description: Spring or fall for comfortable walking weather in Philadelphia and pleasant farm-country drives.
description: Revolutionary War history, then a genuine slice of Amish Country an hour west — the Poconos sit in a different corner of the state and aren't part of this loop.

title: Rhode Island: Providence → Newport → Block Island
best_time_description: June-early September for warm, swimmable water and full ferry schedules to Block Island.
description: America's smallest state, genuinely walkable in one trip — Gilded Age mansions, then a quiet island getaway by ferry.

days.title: Block Island
days.drive_time: Ferry from Point Judith or Newport

title: South Carolina Lowcountry: Charleston → Beaufort → Hilton Head
best_time_description: Spring for azalea blooms in Charleston, or fall for comfortable coastal temperatures. Myrtle Beach sits in the opposite direction up the coast and isn't part of this southward route.
description: A southward run down the Lowcountry coast — Charleston's cobblestones, Beaufort's antebellum quiet, and Hilton Head's beaches.

title: Black Hills & Badlands, South Dakota
best_time_description: September is the sweet spot — warm days, cool nights, and past the early-August Sturgis Motorcycle Rally crowds.
description: Granite spires, an ancient seabed turned badlands, and two mountain carvings, all within about an hour of each other.

title: Big Bend National Park, Texas
best_time_description: Spring (March-April) or fall (October-November) — summer desert heat is genuinely dangerous for hiking here.
description: One of the most remote national parks in the country — desert, canyons, and the Chisos Mountains along the Rio Grande. A standalone trip; Texas Hill Country is 6+ hours away.

title: Utah's Mighty 5
best_time_description: April-May and September-October for mild temperatures across all five parks. Confirm each park's current entry/reservation rules before you go — they've changed more than once in recent years.
description: All five of Utah's national parks in one loop — genuinely the state's signature road trip, and long enough that it deserves the full 10-12 days rather than a rushed week.

days.title: Highway 12 to Escalante
activities: Drive Highway 12, one of the most scenic in the US

title: Vermont: Burlington → Stowe → Manchester
best_time_description: Late September-early October for iconic foliage along Route 100, or late winter for sugarhouse season.
description: Lake Champlain to the Green Mountains — covered bridges, maple sugarhouses, and small-town Vermont at a slow pace.

title: Shenandoah National Park, Virginia
best_time_description: Early-to-mid October for peak Skyline Drive foliage, or spring for wildflowers and fewer crowds. Southwest Virginia and Williamsburg/the coast are each 3+ hours away and separate trips.
description: 105 miles of ridgeline drive, a genuine rock-scramble summit, and one of the East Coast's biggest cave systems, all inside one national park.

title: New River Gorge, West Virginia
best_time_description: September-October for Gauley Season whitewater and rhododendron-lined trails at their best.
description: America's newest national park — one of the longest steel arch bridges in the world spanning a genuine whitewater and rock-climbing destination.

days.title: Bridge Walk & climbing
activities: Bridge Walk tour or rock climbing

title: Door County, Wisconsin
best_time_description: Summer for full ferry and orchard-season access, or fall for color and thinner crowds.
description: The 'Cape Cod of the Midwest' — cherry orchards, uncharacteristically blue Lake Michigan water, and a rooftop of grazing goats.

title: Yellowstone & Grand Teton, Wyoming
best_time_description: Mid-June through early October for full road and trail access. Carry bear spray on every hike.
description: Two adjacent parks connected by a short drive — geothermal wonders in Yellowstone, then the jagged Teton skyline just south of it.

days.title: Beartooth Highway
activities: Drive one of the highest paved roads in the US
